translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Susi inde tulasanna peänäsanna Esau (biasa toi duka' diuaam Edom).
Esau umpobaine tallu to Kanaan: Ada, änä'na to Het isanga Elon, anna Oholibama, änä'na Ana, ampona Zibeon to Hewi,
sola Basmat, adinna Nebayot bassim änä'na Ismael.
Indo Ada undadiam Elifas. Anna indo Basmat undadiam Rehuel,
anna Oholibama undadiam Yeush, Yaelam, anna Korah. Iam too ingganna änä'na Esau nadadiangam bainena dio Kanaan.

Pissam wattu le'ba' Esau umpellei Yakub, adinna, lu lako botto senga'. Umpasola ingganna bainena sola änä'na muane anna baine anna ingganna issi banuanna. Susi toi ingganna dombana, bekena, sapinna, anna ingganna kullena indo pallolonganna dio Kanaan nababa asam.
Buda sugali' kullena nasuhum tä'um deem ongeam la mala naongei sola. Aka indo botto naongei tä'um sihua napa'kambi'i olo'-olo'na aka buda sugali'.
Iam too anna mentieli'um ia Esau, battu diua Edom, le'ba' lako ongeam tipatanete isanga Seir.
Indem ia tulasanna pessubunna Esau, nene kabuttuanna to Edom to tohho dio ongeam tipatanete isanga Seir:

content.text: Änä'na Esau nasibalii Ada isanga Elifas, anna nasibalii Basmat isanga Rehuel, bassim muane.
Elifas undadiam Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gaetam anna Kenas.
Deempi änä'na nadadiangam Timna baine lolä'na Elifas isanga Amalek. Iam too ampona Ada, bainena Esau.
Rehuel ia undadiam Nahat, Zerah, Syama anna Miza. Iam too ampona Basmat, bainena Esau.
Anna Oholibama änä'na Ana, ampona Zibeon undadiangam Esau änä' isanga Yeush, Yaelam anna Korah.

content: Indem ia änä'na sola ampona Esau nene to naponene to umpangngissi mobotto-bottoam:

content.text: Elifas, änä' uluana Esau undadiam nene to naponene to Teman, to Omar, to Zefo, to Kenas,
to Korah, to Gaetam anna to Amalek. Iam too peänäsanna Elifas pessubunna Ada, nasibalii Esau dio Edom.
Anna Rehuel ia, änä'na duka' Esau undadiam nene to naponene to Nahat, to Zerah, to Syama, anna to Miza. Iam too peänäsanna Rehuel, pessubunna Basmat, nasibalii Esau dio Edom.
Oholibama, bainena Esau undadiam nene to naponene to Yeush, to Yaelam, anna to Korah. Iam too peänäsanna Oholibama, indo änä'na Ana.

content: Iam too inde pessubunna Esau sangngim nene to naponene to Edom.
Indem ia änä'na Seir, to Hori, issi litä' dio Edom:

content.text: Lotan, Syobal, Zibeon, Ana,
Disyon, Ezer, anna Disyan. Padam too inde peänäsanna Seir nene to naponene to Hori dio Edom.
Änä'na Lotan isanga Hori anna Heman. Solasubunna Lotan baine isanga Timna.
Änä'na Syobal isanga Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Syefo anna Onam.
Änä'na Zibeon isanga Aya anna Ana. Ana iam too ullambi' kalimbuä kanam dio pohiallasam indo anna le'ba'i ungkambi' keledainna Zibeon ambena.
Änä'na Ana isanga Disyon anna Oholibama, baine ia.
Änä'na Disyon isanga Hemdan, Esyban, Yitran anna Keran.
Änä'na Ezer isanga Bilhan, Zaawan anna Akan.
Änä'na Disyan isanga Us anna Aran.
Iam too inde nene to naponene to Hori: Lotan, Syobal, Zibeon, Ana, Disyon, Ezer anna Disyan situhu' kabuttuanna anna tadongkonganna dio pa'lembängam Seir.

content: Indo anna tä'pi deem tomahajanna to Israel, deemmi ia tomahaja sibala'-bala' ma'pahenta dio Edom. Mate oi mesa, nabala' oom solana. Indo tomahaja isanga:

content.text: Bela änä'na Beor buttu dio mai kota Dinhaba;
Yobab änä'na Zerah buttu dio mai Bozra;
Husyam buttu dio mai Teman;
Hadad änä'na Bedad buttu dio mai Awit (iam too untaloi to Midian indo anna sibundu'i dio lembäna Moab);
Samla to buttu dio mai Masreka;
Saul to buttu dio mai Rehobot dio bihim salu;
Baal-Hanan änä'na Akhbor;
Hadar to buttu dio mai Pahu (bainena isanga Mehetabeel, änä'na Matred, ampona Mezahab).

content: Anna indem ia sanganna botto anna kabuttuanna to umpangngissi Edom, pessubunna Esau: Timna, Alwa, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel anna Iram. Ia asammi too inde sanga dipakonaiam pessubunna anna tadongkonganna si mesa-mesa.
